mapper.select: /* 이메일 HMAC으로 회원 조회 */ SELECT MBR_SN , ATCH_FILE_SN , MBR_STTS_CD , MBR_AUTHRT_CD , JOIN_PATH_CD , ACNT_EML_ENC , MBL_TELNO_ENC , PSWD_HASH , MBR_NCNM , LAST_LGN_DT , WHDWL_DT , NCNM_STNG_CMPTN_YN FROM MBR WHERE ACNT_EML_HMAC = #{acntEmlHmac}
/* 회원 존재 여부 */ SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MBR WHERE MBR_SN = #{mbrSn})

/* 회원 상태 이력 목록 조회 */ SELECT H.MBR_STTS_HSTRY_SN , H.BFR_STTS_CD , H.AFTR_STTS_CD , H.CHG_RSN , H.PRCS_MBR_SN , P.MBR_NCNM AS PRCS_MBR_NCNM , H.REG_DT FROM MBR_STTS_HSTRY H LEFT JOIN MBR P ON P.MBR_SN = H.PRCS_MBR_SN WHERE H.MBR_SN = #{mbrSn} ORDER BY H.REG_DT DESC , H.MBR_STTS_HSTRY_SN DESC

SELECT MBR_SN , ATCH_FILE_SN , MBR_STTS_CD , MBR_AUTHRT_CD , JOIN_PATH_CD , ACNT_EML_ENC , MBL_TELNO_ENC , PSWD_HASH , MBR_NCNM , HLD_PNT , LAST_LGN_DT , SUSPN_END_DT , NCNM_STNG_CMPTN_YN , REG_DT FROM MBR WHERE MBR_SN = #{mbrSn}
SELECT MBR_SN FROM MBR WHERE MBL_TELNO_HMAC = #{mblTelnoHmac} LIMIT 1
SELECT MBR_SN FROM MBR WHERE MBR_NCNM = #{mbrNcnm} LIMIT 1
SELECT SNS_OFFR_CD FROM SNS_ACNT_LINK WHERE MBR_SN = #{mbrSn} AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SNS_ACNT_LINK_SN

/* SNS 제공자 계정에 연결된 회원 조회 */ SELECT M.MBR_SN , M.ATCH_FILE_SN , M.MBR_STTS_CD , M.MBR_AUTHRT_CD , M.JOIN_PATH_CD , M.ACNT_EML_ENC , M.MBL_TELNO_ENC , M.PSWD_HASH , M.MBR_NCNM , M.LAST_LGN_DT , M.WHDWL_DT , M.NCNM_STNG_CMPTN_YN , M.REG_DT FROM SNS_ACNT_LINK L JOIN MBR M ON M.MBR_SN = L.MBR_SN WHERE L.SNS_OFFR_CD = #{snsOffrCd} AND L.OFFR_ACNT_ID = #{offrAcntId} AND L.USE_YN = 'Y'

/* 관리자 탈퇴 회원 목록 조회 : 보관 기간 안의 회원만, 복구 가능 기준과 같다 */ SELECT MBR_SN , MBR_NCNM , ACNT_EML_ENC , WHDWL_DT FROM MBR WHERE MBR_STTS_CD = #{withdrawnSttsCd} AND WHDWL_DT IS NOT NULL AND WHDWL_DT > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{keepDayCnt} DAY) ORDER BY WHDWL_DT DESC , MBR_SN DESC

/* 관리자 목록 조회 : 지정일시는 최근 지정 기록, 기록이 없으면 NULL 로 맨 뒤 */ SELECT M.MBR_SN , M.MBR_NCNM , M.ACNT_EML_ENC , (SELECT MAX(L.REG_DT) FROM MNGR_TASK_LOG L WHERE L.TRGT_TBL_NM = #{trgtTblNm} AND L.TRGT_SN = M.MBR_SN AND L.TASK_SMRY_CN = #{taskSmryCn}) AS APNT_DT FROM MBR M WHERE M.MBR_AUTHRT_CD = #{adminAuthrtCd} AND M.MBR_STTS_CD <> #{withdrawnSttsCd} ORDER BY APNT_DT DESC , M.MBR_SN DESC

/* 관리자 대시보드 회원 건수 : 가입 수는 상태 무관, 최근 7일은 오늘 포함 */ SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN MBR_STTS_CD IN (#{nrmlSttsCd}, #{stopSttsCd}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS TOT_MBR_CNT , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN MBR_STTS_CD = #{nrmlSttsCd} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS NRML_MBR_CNT , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN MBR_STTS_CD = #{stopSttsCd} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS STOP_MBR_CNT , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN REG_DT >= CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS TODAY_JOIN_CNT , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN REG_DT >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS WEEK_JOIN_CNT FROM MBR WHERE MBR_AUTHRT_CD = #{mbrAuthrtCd}

/* 관리자 대시보드 일별 가입·탈퇴 수 : 가입은 상태 무관, 둘 다 없는 날은 행이 없다 */ SELECT T.YMD , SUM(T.JOIN_CNT) AS JOIN_CNT , SUM(T.WHDWL_CNT) AS WHDWL_CNT FROM (SELECT DATE(REG_DT) AS YMD , 1 AS JOIN_CNT , 0 AS WHDWL_CNT FROM MBR WHERE MBR_AUTHRT_CD = #{mbrAuthrtCd} AND REG_DT >= #{fromDt} AND REG_DT < #{toDt} UNION ALL SELECT DATE(WHDWL_DT) AS YMD , 0 AS JOIN_CNT , 1 AS WHDWL_CNT FROM MBR WHERE MBR_AUTHRT_CD = #{mbrAuthrtCd} AND WHDWL_DT >= #{fromDt} AND WHDWL_DT < #{toDt}) T GROUP BY T.YMD ORDER BY T.YMD
